svg.title: GraphCodeRAG full system architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end architecture showing data source, ingestion pipeline with 4 stages, dual storage layer with FAISS and Neo4j, hybrid retrieval engine with metadata filtering, LLM generation, evaluation suite, and web interface
